Name: Cleopas
Summary: Cleopas was one of the two disciples who met the risen Jesus on the road to Emmaus and recognised Him in the breaking of bread. He is traditionally identified with Cleophas, the husband of Mary named at the cross in John's Gospel.
KeyStory: Cleopas walked seven miles with a stranger who opened the Scriptures, and knew Him when He broke the bread.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Mary, Mother of James and Joses
LifeLesson: Jesus meets us on ordinary roads and opens the Scriptures before He opens our eyes. Walk with Him and listen.
